prompt:
You are solving a logic puzzle. Read all the clues carefully.

A conservation map divides a reserve into twenty sectors. Color each region with red, green or blue. A region pair separated by a dash denotes a direct link. Linked regions must have different colors. The links work both ways. The regions are Bank, Birch, Cove, Crest, Dale, Delta, Falls, Fen, Grove, Heath, Hill, Hollow, Lagoon, Meadow, Moss, Pass, Pines, Pool, Shoal, Spur.
1. Delta is blue.
2. Pines is green.
3. Delta–Falls, Delta–Hollow, Delta–Pass, Delta–Pines, Delta–Pool.
4. Falls–Hollow, Falls–Meadow, Falls–Moss, Falls–Pines, Falls–Shoal.
5. Hollow–Pass, Hollow–Shoal.
6. Cove–Crest, Cove–Falls, Cove–Heath, Cove–Hill, Cove–Hollow.
7. Crest–Heath, Crest–Hollow, Crest–Pool.
8. Meadow–Pines.
9. Bank–Cove, Bank–Dale, Bank–Delta, Bank–Fen, Bank–Pool.
10. Moss–Pines, Moss–Spur.
11. Birch–Crest, Birch–Hill, Birch–Moss.
12. Heath–Lagoon, Heath–Pass, Heath–Shoal.
13. Fen–Moss, Fen–Spur.
14. Grove–Meadow, Grove–Shoal, Grove–Spur.
15. Dale–Fen, Dale–Hill.
16. Lagoon–Pass, Lagoon–Spur.
For each named region, give its color.

Required output format:
Variables to report: Delta, Pines, Falls, Hollow, Cove, Crest, Meadow, Pool, Bank, Moss, Birch, Heath, Hill, Fen, Spur, Shoal, Grove, Dale, Pass, Lagoon
Possible values: red, green, blue
Reply with ONE JSON object that maps every listed variable to its value, e.g. {"Ana": 1, "Bruno": 2}.

Reply with ONLY the JSON, no markdown and no extra text.
